description: Source file implementing the QuicSpdyClientSessionBase class, which manages HTTP/3 and HTTP/2 client sessions over QUIC, including handling push promises, headers, and connection settings.

classes.name: QuicSpdyClientSessionBase
classes.description: Manages a QUIC client session with HTTP/3 and HTTP/2 support, handling push promises, headers, and connection settings.

methods.name: QuicSpdyClientSessionBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with connection, visitor, push promise index, config, and supported versions.

methods.name: ~QuicSpdyClientSessionBase
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up promised streams and erasing related entries.

methods.name: OnInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Processes headers once initial headers are received for a stream.

methods.name: OnPromiseHeaderList
methods.description: Handles received push promise headers, validating and associating them with streams.

methods.name: HandlePromised
methods.description: Handles a promised stream, checking for duplicates and limits, and creating promised info.

methods.name: GetPromisedById
methods.description: Retrieves promised info by stream ID.

methods.name: GetPromisedStream
methods.description: Gets the promised stream object by ID.

methods.name: DeletePromised
methods.description: Deletes a promised stream and cleans up references.

methods.name: ResetPromised
methods.description: Resets a promised stream with an error code.

methods.name: ShouldReleaseHeadersStreamSequencerBuffer
methods.description: Determines if headers stream buffer should be released.

methods.name: ShouldKeepConnectionAlive
methods.description: Checks if the connection should be kept alive.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrame
methods.description: Processes received settings frame and updates connection state accordingly.
